name: Emily The Exhibitionist
source:
Emily The Exhibitionist is made up of 3 short stories and 3 mini-games:

Emily The Exhibitionist: Emily is a University student with a habit for snitching on other students. After Su steals her clothes to teach her a lesson, Emily now needs to make the right choices in order to get home without being seen.

Emily The Exhibitionist Part 2: Emily is stuck in a time loop, repeatedly waking up in a broken-down elevator...naked. Once again, she'll need to make the right choices to save her pride and, this time, the University. Helped by Willow, Su, and a mysterious streaker.

Alice Returns: After getting lost driving through the woods in a storm, Nova rushes to a nearby house in the middle of nowhere, where she meets two sisters, Alice and Ashley. Alice seems irritable and is clearly not happy about Nova's presence, whereas Ashley just wants to have fun with her. Meanwhile, something spooky is lurking in the woods.

Strip Blackjack: 
Ai-Chan The Student - After accidentally walking in on Ai-Chan naked, she now wants revenge and blackmails you into playing Strip Blackjack. Just try not to get caught...

Harmony The Nudist - While walking through a seemingly empty beach, you're approached by a very naked Harmony, a friend from the University. Realizing it's a nude beach, you get uncomfortable as she tries to help you relax. Later that day, Harmony meets you in private and challenges you to Strip Blackjack to help you get comfortable with seeing her naked. After all, she just wants a nudist friend

Nova The Magician - Nova is having some anxiety about performing on stage, and she picks you, a random student, out from the hallway to keep her company and help her practice her magic before she has to perform. She wants to play Strip Blackjack and show off her tricks to help take her mind off things, anything but put her magician's outfit on.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4089090/Emily_The_Exhibitionist/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《暴露狂艾米丽》由3个短篇故事和3个小游戏组成：

暴露狂艾米丽：艾米丽是一名大学生，有向其他学生告密的习惯。苏偷了她的衣服来教训她之后，艾米丽现在需要做出正确的选择，才能不被发现地回家。

暴露狂艾米丽第二部分：艾米丽被困在时间循环中，反复在坏掉的电梯里醒来……赤身裸体。她需要再一次做出正确的选择，以挽救她的骄傲，这一次，也是为了大学。得到威洛、苏和神秘裸奔者的帮助。

爱丽丝归来：在暴风雨中开车穿过树林迷路后，诺娃冲到附近一所偏僻的房子，在那里她遇到了两姐妹，爱丽丝和阿什莉。爱丽丝看起来很烦躁，显然对诺瓦的存在不满意，而阿什利只是想和她一起玩。与此同时，树林里潜伏着某种令人毛骨悚然的东西。

脱衣二十一点：
学生爱酱 - 在不小心裸体地走进爱酱后，她现在想要报复并勒索你玩脱衣二十一点。只是尽量不要被抓住…

Harmony裸体主义者 - 当你走过看似空旷的海滩时，一个非常裸体的Harmony走近了你，他是大学里的朋友。意识到这是一个裸体海滩，当她试图帮助你放松时，你会感到不舒服。当天晚些时候，Harmony会私下与你会面，并向你挑战脱衣二十一点，以帮助你适应看到她的裸体。毕竟，她只是想要一个裸体主义者朋友

魔术师诺娃 - 诺娃对在舞台上表演感到有些焦虑，她从走廊里随机挑选了你，一个学生，陪伴她，并帮助她在表演前练习魔法。她想玩脱衣二十一点并展示她的技巧来帮助她转移注意力，但除了穿上魔术师的服装外。
